groups.heading: COMPARATIVE NUANCE
items: OPTIONAL DEPTH 1 — The Mimamsa Project: Knowledge in the Service of Vedic duty
(dharma) Advanced normativity without divine command The school's unity lies in its governing problem.
Vedic duty (dharma) cannot be perceived, while ordinary inference cannot independently establish ritual obligation.
Vedic injunction therefore supplies normative knowledge, semantics explains sentence-unity, and unseen ritual potency (apūrva) explains delayed efficacy.
